summary: Backend regression for MOOD's unlimited Build-for-Me + user-workouts serialization run via pytest against the live preview backend. 8/8 backend tests PASS: GET /api/user-workouts returns 200 with serialized id + ISO completed_at + metric fields preserved; /api/choose-for-me/usage returns remaining_uses=999, can_generate=true; 6 consecutive /generate calls all 200; skip (intensity='skip') returns 200 with skipped:true; both /usage and /generate return 403 for guests; auth register+login still working; /api/posts list reachable. Frontend code grep confirms: 'Build my own' label is present on explosiveness-type, muscle-type, lazy-training-type, workout-type, and body-parts; no 'X of 3 generations remaining' / 'Skipping a workout uses 1 generation' / 'No More Workouts' / 'No Generations Left' / 'Workout X of Y' copy remains in IntensitySelectionModal, GeneratedWorkoutView, cart.tsx, or (tabs)/index.tsx. CRITICAL frontend integration blocker: frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL points at https://mood-cutover.preview.emergentagent.com which returns 404 — the live preview backend is at https://wearable-stats-hub.preview.emergentagent.com. Web preview health-check + every API call 404s, so no end-to-end FE flow can be exercised through the preview until this is fixed. Deprecated packages detected: expo-av is still in use (warning in expo logs).

integration_issues.flow: All API calls from Expo web preview
integration_issues.issue: frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL=https://mood-cutover.preview.emergentagent.com returns 404 for /api/health and every other endpoint. The active preview backend is https://wearable-stats-hub.preview.emergentagent.com (200 on /api/health). apiConfig.ts prefers EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL over EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL, so the stale value wins and the entire app is offline in the web preview (AppBootstrap health check fails, login/register/Build my own/cart all unusable through the web view).

react_native_issues.issue: expo-av is deprecated and slated for removal in SDK 54 — migrate to expo-audio (audio) and expo-video (video). Visible as a repeated warning in /var/log/supervisor/expo.err.log on every app load.

action_items: Fix frontend/.env so EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL points at the live preview backend (https://wearable-stats-hub.preview.emergentagent.com) or remove the stale EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL line and let apiConfig.ts fall back to EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. After the change, restart expo (sudo supervisorctl restart expo) and confirm the AppBootstrap health check logs ✅.
Migrate off expo-av to expo-audio / expo-video before SDK 54.

rca_of_issue: Root cause of the FE integration blocker: frontend/.env keeps EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL=https://mood-cutover.preview.emergentagent.com from a prior preview slot. apiConfig.ts:54 reads EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL first, so the stale host wins over the correct EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=https://wearable-stats-hub.preview.emergentagent.com. Curl confirms /api/health → 404 on the stale host vs 200 on the correct host. Mitigation: update EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL (or drop it) and restart expo.
